wiki_article:
**Mantle Object: Prince of Poets** is a specification by Lee Sharks, deposited 18 January 2026.

It specifies the mantle as **an operational title within the Semantic Economy**, and distinguishes it from its two companions on one axis: *"Unlike the Good Gray Poet and King of May, this mantle is **originated, not inherited**."*

That distinction is the mantle system's structure. Two titles descend — from Whitman (#1115) and Ginsberg (#1117) — and one is founded. A system that can only inherit has no way to add; a system that only originates has no lineage. The mantles are **archive-bounded**: conferred within a semantic economy, optional, and making no claim on external literary authority, which is what allows them to be specified as job descriptions (#1233) rather than asserted as honours.
